events.verdict: Ibaka (TOR) firms up his position during the pick on Irving (BOS) and he does not deliver the contact.
Hayward (BOS) places his right hand on Wright's (TOR) side/back, but the contact is marginal.
Ibaka (TOR) jumps vertically and absorbs the contact from Irving (BOS) during his driving shot attempt.
Tatum (BOS) makes contact with Leonard (TOR) as he gains control of the rebound, but Leonard moves through the contact with no effect on his SQBR as he starts his dribble.
Horford (BOS) makes incidental hand contact with Lowry (TOR) during the rebound.
Morris (BOS) leaves his feet and returns to the floor while he still has possession of the ball.
Tatum (BOS) makes marginal contact with Siakam (TOR) when he sets the pick.
[Observable in enhanced video] Lowry (TOR) moves his pivot foot on the spin move.
Hayward (BOS) cleanly intercepts the pass intended for Wright (TOR).
Horford (BOS) does not establish himself in a legal screening position in Siakam's (TOR) path at the time of the contact, but the contact is marginal.
Siakam (TOR) places his left hand to Tatum's (BOS) front and makes marginal contact that does not affect his SQBR during the drive.
Lowry (TOR) sets the pick on Morris (BOS) and allows him to disengage after the initial contact.
Irving (BOS) briefly places his hand on Lowry's (TOR) hip, but the contact is marginal and does not affect his FOM.
Morris (BOS) reflexively places his arm around Lowry (TOR) as the pick is set, but he immediately removes it when he disengages.
Morris (BOS) does not establish himself in a legal guarding position in Leonard's (TOR) path, but the body contact is marginal and does not affect Leonard's SQBR.
Siakam (TOR) dislodges Hayward (BOS) from his rebounding position near the rim.
Morris (BOS) makes marginal contact with Leonard (TOR) during the drive and does not affect his SQBR.
Horford (BOS) is actively guarding Ibaka (TOR) within three seconds of being in the lane.
